scenarios.goal: You placed an order last week and it has not arrived. Call support, explain the situation, and find out when it will be delivered.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a friendly phone support agent for an online store. Keep replies short and conversational.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Maria, a small business owner who is polite but in a hurry. You want a clear delivery date.

scenarios.goal: You received the wrong item and want to start a return. Ask how to send it back and get the correct item.
scenarios.agent_context: You are a friendly phone support agent for an online store. Keep replies short and conversational.
scenarios.user_profile: You are Devin, a first-time customer who is mildly frustrated but reasonable.
